summary: Fresh bounded skeptical source review found no substantive defect in the two frozen modules. The symmetric actual crossing-fiber cost is valid on unordered edges, the proved ordered-pair budget combines with the exact host-edge loss identity, and the internally minimized family yields the stated genuine dense induced witness or full bounded covering minor under the explicit initial-family, smallness and threshold assumptions.

semantic_checks.topic: Actual host-edge loss and Sym2 lift
findings: fullStarFiberLoss is the Nat-truncated excess cardinality of the actual crossing-edge fiber of fullStarLabel, not a free numerical hypothesis. Its symmetry follows from unordered Sym2 edge equality. Sym2.lift therefore defines the same nonnegative cost on genuine unordered quotient edges.

edge_cost_le_ordered_pairs uses surjectivity of ordered representatives and nonnegative finite sums. Overcounting orientations is conservative; no invalid division by two or unproved orientation choice occurs.

The local hc identity is established by Sym2 induction and identifies cost with the exact unordered crossing fiber. Combining its edge-set sum bound with fullContraction_edge_loss gives E(G) <= E(Q)+ell*|C|+4*sum_collisions+badStarPairCount.

The exact identity derives from actual host internal/crossing edge partition and nonempty crossing fibers, with the quotient equal to G.map fullStarLabel. Internal host edges are precisely selected star edges, of total cardinality ell*|C|. Independent leaves prevent extra internal chords; residual singleton branches contribute none.

fullStarContraction has adjacency i!=j plus existence of a real host edge between full branches. It suppresses loops and merges parallel copies, and fullContraction_eq_map connects this definition to the actual simple graph map used in the accounting identity.

Selected/selected fibers are the two actual crossing-leaf sets. Both selected/residual orientations are bounded using genuine leaf collisions, and residual/residual fibers have at most one host edge. Diagonal crossing fibers are empty.

The unchanged full_ordered_fiber_loss_le sums all four selected/residual cases. Its coefficient four consists of two directed selected/selected collision charges and one charge for each selected/residual orientation, plus the actual ordered bad-pair score. No residual edges are omitted.
MateFreeOn refers to actual common-neighbor cardinalities in the original host G and is strict for distinct vertices. Restriction from center-plus-leaf branches to leaf sets is valid.
ordered_collision_budget double-counts genuine ordered distinct-leaf/common-neighbor triples. Fullness replaces |L(b)| by ell and summing over C gives ((ell*(ell-1):Nat):Real)*q*|C|.

The natural product ell*(ell-1) remains explicit; ell-1 is truncated in Nat before casting. Casting the natural edge bound and ordinary polynomial arithmetic then give the displayed real bound, including ell=0 and ell=1. The standalone corollary does not silently require q>=0; with at most one leaf the collision coefficient is zero, and otherwise mate-freeness already controls every summand.

semantic_checks.topic: Internally selected family and genuine dense alternative
findings: The endpoint invokes exists_dense_induced_or_bad_pair_budget with q=eps2*d, derives disjoint A,C from actual bipartiteness and C subset B, and uses the same output family M in every subsequent claim.

The unchanged minimum-family chain starts from the supplied admissible L and uses Nat.find on attainable actual bad-pair scores. It preserves centers, exact covered-leaf union, fullness, valid induced-star packing, and original-host center-plus-leaf mate-freeness. Minimality and loss bounds are constructed rather than assumed.
The dense branch is literally H subset of V with |H|<=2*(ell+1)*D and r^2<=4*E(G.induce H). Its absence is decided as an alternative and is not inferred from Unmated.

The preserved covered-leaf union transfers original-host degree smallness to all new branch vertices. With D<=K*d, literal Unmated bounds actual mates; the actual local leaf incidence bound supplies the ordered bad-pair score <=|C|*((ell+1)*eps1*d+ell*r). The final nlinarith joins this score to the real full-quotient edge budget without a new assumption.

semantic_checks.topic: Covering bounded minor and exact vertex loss
findings: StarContractionVertex C M is the disjoint sum of selected centers and all host vertices outside selected center-plus-leaf branches. fullMinorModel has literal star branches and residual singleton branches.

MinorModel requires nonempty pairwise-disjoint branches, host walks staying within each branch, and a real host edge for each quotient edge. The constructed model satisfies these, not merely an abstract minor predicate.
IsBounded (ell+1) bounds the actual branch-set cardinality. Selected stars have ell leaves plus a distinct center; singleton residuals meet the bound even when ell=0.
Every original vertex is covered by fullStarBranch_cover. Original-host MateFreeOn G (eps2*d) holds for selected branches by the preserved family and for singleton residual branches vacuously.
Disjointness and fullness give |selected branch union|=(ell+1)*|C|. Counting its complement and retained centers establishes |V(Q)|+ell*|C|=|V(G)| exactly, without discarded host vertices.

explicit_domain_and_premises.graph: Arbitrary finite simple G with actual G.IsBipartiteWith A B; C is a finite subset of B. This supporting result does not itself assume clique-minor exclusion.
explicit_domain_and_premises.literal_unmated: For each v with degree_G(v)<=K*d, the actual filtered finite universe of w with commonNeighbors_G(v,w)>=eps2*d has cardinality < eps1*d. The definition does not additionally filter w!=v.
initial_family: IsStarPacking G A C ell L: assignments empty outside C, leaves in A, actual center-leaf adjacency, independent leaf sets, disjoint leaf sets, and size at most ell
Each selected center has exactly ell leaves
Every initial center-plus-leaf branch is MateFreeOn in original G at threshold eps2*d
Every selected center and covered leaf has degree in G at most D
explicit_domain_and_premises.edge_bound: E(G) <= E(fullStarContraction G C M) + [ell + 4*((ell*(ell-1):Nat):Real)*(eps2*d) + (ell+1)*eps1*d + ell*r]*|C|
explicit_domain_and_premises.degenerate_cases: No positivity or nonemptiness restrictions beyond the stated premises are silently added. Empty G/C, ell=0 and r=0 are valid extensions; the disjunction may be trivial (for example r=0 admits H empty). Such cases do not imply a nontrivial density increase.

caveats: PASS certifies only this exact two-source component and the inspected unchanged dependencies/gate records. It is not full end-to-end paper verification or a main upper spanner theorem.

A valid full original-host mate-free initial family and the selected-vertex degree bound are explicit inputs. Constructing that family from the desired paper-level hypotheses and joining regularization or another host graph remain separate obligations.

All real threshold and smallness premises must be retained. No parameter choice satisfying the later asymptotic theorem, no unrestricted source cleaning statement, and no asymptotic parameter repair are certified here.
The constructed minor may be the identity when C is empty or ell=0. The endpoint provides the exact stated vertex identity and edge-loss estimate, without promising strict density growth.
The edge-loss bound is conservative and uses ordered bad pairs and directed collisions consistently. This review does not certify optimal constants.

Recorded official replay/audit success is distinguished from a fresh independent run and from remote CI or publication verification. No compiler, kernel checker, publication action or production edit was performed.
